grand_strategy.reading:
Slovakia is the case of a small, trade-dependent member state that uses
the rules of the club it belongs to as its main instrument against the
club. Fico has no army to speak of, no oil, and an export economy
wired into German supply chains; what he has is unanimity. The 2023-26
pattern is therefore linkage: a veto (the 18th and 20th sanctions
packages, Ukraine's loan, the accession clusters) is held until a
concrete good is released - gas guarantees, Druzhba oil, a hearing. That
is Luttwak's paradoxical logic in a small space: the weaker the state,
the more it relies on the one resource, procedure, that its partners
cannot take away without breaking their own rules. But the lever
consumes itself. Hungary under Orban was the other half of the veto
axis; after Magyar's win in April 2026 Bratislava is alone, the
Parliament has asked for conditionality, and the Visegrad revival is
being run by Tusk, Babis and Magyar, not by Fico. Two signals that are
not rows: Fico took the Moscow trip again in May 2026 after having
been shot in 2024 and after a year of mass protest, which shows that
the trips are a message to a domestic electorate and not a
diplomatic programme (OSW and others make this reading of the
American hardware too); and on 18 Sep 2026 he said he would not
be 'part of any military conflict because of Article 5' - a statement
that, if believed, hollows out the alliance whose F-16s he is flying.
The coalition crisis of September 2026 may end the story before the
2027 election: the structural question is whether his successor,
whoever it is, will inherit a state that has learned to veto or one
that has learned to be vetoed.

stances.note: Transactional cooperation and a leader-level warmth no other EU government shows: Fico met Putin on 22 Dec 2024 (gas), on 9 May 2025, in Beijing on 2 Sep 2025 and again in Moscow on 9 May 2026; Slovakia buys Gazprom gas to 2034 and Druzhba crude, and in 2025 'increased Russian gas imports to normalise relations with Moscow' (Reuters). Partner, not ally: Slovakia is in NATO and the EU, supplies no weapons to Russia, and still voted for the sanctions packages after delay; the 2026 oil row showed that Moscow's pipeline obeys Ukraine's and Russia's war, not Fico's diplomacy. Warming because the visits went from one (2024) to three in 18 months. Bond affinity: Slavic sympathy that Fico cultivates and 1945 memory, not kinship. Partner of Russia while Poland holds Russia as adversary: the pair SVK-POL stays reluctant_ally for that reason.

Since 10 Jan 2026 Slovakia gives no state military aid, no troops and no share of EU loan guarantees; it stayed out of the EUR 90bn loan, cut emergency electricity in Feb 2026 and held the 20th package and Ukraine's accession hostage to the Druzhba restart (22-23 Apr).
